note: Coarse denominators for mayor-ready 'who is affected' — Census/IDP/operational order-of-magnitude. Never invent finer numbers than the source supports.

clinic_waiting_days.method: Illustrative share of metro population reliant on public PHC; replace with City Health facility catchment rollup.
clinic_waiting_days.source_label: Census 2022 metro pop × public-sector PHC dependence (illustrative)
gaps: Official City Health waiting-time extract by facility not yet wired
Provincial hospital occupancy is Western Cape DoH — not City-owned
vulnerability_notes: Longer waits hit uninsured households hardest
Chronic-care and maternal clients absorb queue risk disproportionately

ems_response_minutes.geography: City of Cape Town metro (EMS coverage area)
ems_response_minutes.method: Full metro population as EMS service footprint; refine with P1 call volumes by district when available.
ems_response_minutes.source_label: City of Cape Town population estimate
gaps: P1 call volumes by district not yet in Helm facts store
vulnerability_notes: Minutes above urban benchmark raise outcome risk on life-threatening calls

non_revenue_water_pct.geography: Western Cape Water Supply System / City reticulation customers
non_revenue_water_pct.method: Metro population as water-service denominator; losses raise scarcity and cost for all billed households.
gaps: Zone-level NRW not yet attached — city-wide % only
vulnerability_notes: Informal and high-loss zones feel scarcity and interruptions first

dam_storage.geography: Western Cape Water Supply System users (City of Cape Town share)
dam_storage.method: Metro population dependent on WCWSS bulk storage.
dam_storage.source_label: DWS weekly dam levels + City water services
vulnerability_notes: Low storage raises restriction risk for all households before summer peak

road_maintenance_backlog_km.method: Metro population as mobility denominator; backlog concentrates vehicle damage and stormwater failure risk.
gaps: Ward-level backlog km not yet published into Helm
vulnerability_notes: Public-transport dependent residents absorb delays and safety risk on degraded corridors

refuse_service_requests.method: Metro population under municipal collection mandate.
gaps: Precinct-level illegal dumping hotspots not yet linked
vulnerability_notes: Missed collections and dumping concentrate in dense lower-income areas

public_lighting_outages.geography: Estimate of residents in high night-time pedestrian / PT-wait zones (illustrative)
public_lighting_outages.method: Subset of metro pop weighted to areas where lighting failure most affects perceived safety; refine with outage GIS.
gaps: Need outage tickets joined to ward population
vulnerability_notes: Women and evening PT users feel dark streets first

library_visits.method: Social outcome metric — no city-wide affected count until facility catchments are attached.
gaps: Facility-level catchments not in facts store — secondary to Health/Safety/Housing
vulnerability_notes: Useful citizen-experience signal; not a mayor P0 sector

housing_population.method: IDP / housing database backlog order-of-magnitude pending official refresh.
gaps: Monthly delivery vs budgeted units not yet a time series in Helm
vulnerability_notes: Backlog households are the clearest housing demographic denominator

safety_policing.method: Await SAPS quarter + precinct population join before publishing a count.
gaps: Exact SAPS quarter and precinct list required before crime claims
Precinct population denominators not yet joined
vulnerability_notes: Contact crime concentrates in a minority of precincts — attach before briefing

health.method: See clinic_waiting_days. Hospitals: Western Cape Department of Health — linked externally, not City-owned.
gaps: Provincial hospital beds/occupancy not in City facts store
Facility-level waiting times pending official extract
vulnerability_notes: City owns clinics & EMS pathways; acute hospitals are provincial
Always say so in the room — do not invent hospital stats
